title.english: The Empty Box on the Form

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dìèrtiān qǐ dé zǎo ,
pairs.english: Tavi got up quite early the next day,

pairs.target: xiǎng qù zàojiān jiè yìzhī kōng fànhé .
pairs.english: hoping to go to the kitchen and borrow an empty lunchbox.
pairs.hanzi: 想去灶间借一只空饭盒。

pairs.target: tā dǎsuàn yòng tā zhuāng chuánhuà de zhǐ ,
pairs.english: He planned to use it to carry notes for passing messages,
pairs.hanzi: 他打算用它装传话的纸，

pairs.target: shěngde yílù bǎ zhǐ zuàn chūhàn .
pairs.english: so he wouldn't sweat all over the paper by gripping it the whole way.

pairs.target: guǎn zào de rén jiēkāi gài gěi tā kàn ,
pairs.english: The person in charge of the stove lifted the lid for him to see.
pairs.hanzi: 管灶的人揭开盖给他看，

pairs.target: lǐtou háiyǒu bànkuài zuóyè liúxià de bǐng .
pairs.english: Inside there was still half a cake left over from last night.
pairs.hanzi: 里头还有半块昨夜留下的饼。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi nà shì gěi zìjǐ de ,
pairs.english: Tavi assumed that it was meant for him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为那是给自己的，

pairs.target: shǒu gāng shēnjìnqù ,
pairs.english: His hand had only just reached in

pairs.target: duìfāng jiù bǎ hézi yì zhuǎn ,
pairs.english: when the cook gave the box a turn.

pairs.target: shuō bǐng děng rén lái qǔ ,
pairs.english: The cook said the cake was waiting for someone to come and collect it.

pairs.target: hézi kěyǐ jiè ,
pairs.english: The box was available to borrow,

pairs.target: dé děng bǐng zǒu le zàishuō .
pairs.english: but they'd have to wait until the cake was gone and talk then.

pairs.target: tā zhàn zhe děng le yíhuìer ,
pairs.english: He waited on his feet for a bit,

pairs.target: zhōngyú wèn nàge rén shénme shíhòu lái .
pairs.english: finally asking when the person would come.
pairs.hanzi: 终于问那个人什么时候来。

pairs.target: guǎn zào de shuō bù zhīdào , rénjiā zhǐ shuō zǎochén .
pairs.english: The cook said they didn't know: the person had only said morning.
pairs.hanzi: 管灶的说不知道，人家只说早晨。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi huí lóushàng qǔ le zìjǐ de yóubù ,
pairs.english: Tavi went back upstairs to fetch his very own oilcloth,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维回楼上取了自己的油布，

pairs.target: méi zài děng hézi .
pairs.english: and didn't wait any longer for the box.

pairs.target: zǒu dào lóutī guǎiwānchù ,
pairs.english: At the turn in the stairs,

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ zuóyè nà zhāng biǎo shàng ,
pairs.english: he remembered that on the form from last night

pairs.target: zìjǐ xiě de yě shì zǎochén .
pairs.english: he himself had written morning too.

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī hái méi dào jiàoshì .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian hadn't reached the classroom yet.

pairs.target: mǐlā zhàn le chuāng xià de yì jié chángdèng ,
pairs.english: Mira had claimed a stretch of bench under the window
pairs.hanzi: 米拉占了窗下的一截长凳，

pairs.target: zhèng ná liǎngpiàn báo mù shì yìzhī jiù xiāo tào .
pairs.english: and was testing an old bushing with two thin pieces of wood.
pairs.hanzi: 正拿两片薄木试一只旧销套。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ yóu bùsāijìn bāo ,
pairs.english: Tavi stuffed the oilcloth into his bag

pairs.target: shēnshǒu tì tā àn mùpiàn .
pairs.english: and reached out to hold the wood down for her.

pairs.target: tā lìkè jiào tā sōngkāi .
pairs.english: She immediately told him to let go.

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi yòu pèng le tā bùxǔ pèng de dōngxī ,
pairs.english: He thought he had again touched something she'd forbidden him to touch,
pairs.hanzi: 他以为又碰了她不许碰的东西，

pairs.target: máng jiāng liǎngshǒu jǔ qǐlái .
pairs.english: and quickly raised both hands.

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō : " wǒ qǐng nǐ ná zhe , méi qǐng nǐ náwěn .
pairs.english: Mira said, “I asked you to hold it, I did not ask you to hold it steady.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说：“我请你拿着，没请你拿稳。

pairs.target: dé kàn tā zìjǐ wǎng nǎbiān dǎo . "
pairs.english: We need to see which way it falls on its own.”

pairs.target: báo mù guǒrán dǎo le ,
pairs.english: Sure enough, the thin wood fell,

pairs.target: luò zài tā xī shàng .
pairs.english: landing right on his lap.

pairs.target: tā jiǎnqǐlái ,
pairs.english: He picked it up

pairs.target: wèn tā yào jìxià nǎ yìbiān .
pairs.english: and asked which side she wanted noted down.

pairs.target: mǐlā yòng zhǐjié qiāo le qiāo dèng miàn .
pairs.english: Mira knocked on the bench surface with a knuckle.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉用指节敲了敲凳面。

pairs.target: dèngzǐ zài chuāng xià xiàng lǐ xié ,
pairs.english: The bench slanted in toward the room under the window.

pairs.target: dǎo xiàqù de wèibì shì xiāo tào sōng de nà tóu .
pairs.english: The side that fell wasn't necessarily the end with the loose bushing.
pairs.hanzi: 倒下去的未必是销套松的那头。

pairs.target: tā jiāng dōngxī bān dào shí chuāngtáishàng ,
pairs.english: She moved everything to the stone windowsill
pairs.hanzi: 她将东西搬到石窗台上，

pairs.target: chóngxīn bǎihǎo ,
pairs.english: and set it up again.

pairs.target: zhècì cái qǐng tā fú zhe dǐxià nà piàn mùtou .
pairs.english: Only this time did she ask him to steady the piece of wood underneath.
pairs.hanzi: 这次才请他扶着底下那片木头。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fú le yízhèn ,
pairs.english: Tavi held it awhile,

pairs.target: zhǐjiān bèi chuāngfèng lǐ de fēngchuī liáng le .
pairs.english: his fingertips growing cold as the wind blew in through a crack in the window.
pairs.hanzi: 指尖被窗缝里的风吹凉了。

pairs.target: děng tā shuō kěyǐ fàng , tā cái gǎndòng .
pairs.english: Only when she said he could let go did he dare move.
pairs.hanzi: 等她说可以放，他才敢动。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zǎochén děng hézi de shì jiǎng gěi tā tīng .
pairs.english: He told her all about the business of his wait for the box that morning.
pairs.hanzi: 他把早晨等盒子的事讲给她听。

pairs.target: mǐlā wèn tā wèishénme bù bǎ bǐng dàizǒu ,
pairs.english: Mira asked why he hadn't taken the cake away
pairs.hanzi: 米拉问他为什么不把饼带走，

pairs.target: děng rén lái zài hái .
pairs.english: and waited till the person came before giving it back.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō nà yòu búshì zìjǐ de bǐng .
pairs.english: Tavi said that wasn't even a cake of his.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说那又不是自己的饼。

pairs.target: tā xiào le , shuō nà nǐ dǎo zhīdào bùnéng tìrén dìng yídùnfàn ,
pairs.english: She laughed and said, “So at least you know not to decide someone's meal for them,
pairs.hanzi: 她笑了，说那你倒知道不能替人定一顿饭，

pairs.target: zěnme dào le zhǐ shàng , biàn tìrén dìng hǎo yì zhěnggè zǎochén .
pairs.english: but why, when it comes to paper, do you settle a whole morning for them?”
pairs.hanzi: 怎么到了纸上，便替人定好一整个早晨。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī jìnmén shí ,
pairs.english: When Instructor Jian came through the door,

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén zhèngzài zhēng zǎochén cóng shénme shíhòu suàn qǐ .
pairs.english: the two were arguing about what time counted as the start of morning.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人正在争早晨从什么时候算起。

pairs.target: lǎoshī méi tì tāmen cáidìng ,
pairs.english: The teacher didn't settle it for them.

pairs.target: zhī wènhòu chēpéng kāimén shí shuí zài .
pairs.english: She only asked who was there when the waiting shelter opened.
pairs.hanzi: 只问候车棚开门时谁在。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō duàn yí , yě kěnéng shì lìng yìbān de rén .
pairs.english: Tavi said Auntie Duan, or possibly it would be a person from another shift.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说段姨，也可能是另一班的人。

pairs.target: tā yuánxiān zhī xiě le duàn yí de míngzì ,
pairs.english: He had originally written only the name of Auntie Duan,
pairs.hanzi: 他原先只写了段姨的名字，

pairs.target: méi wèn guò tā nǎ tiān dāngbān .
pairs.english: without asking what day she was on duty.

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī ràng tā zài kōnglán lǐ xiān xiěxià bù zhīdào ,
pairs.english: Instructor Jian told him to write “unknown” in the empty box for now,
pairs.hanzi: 简老师让他在空栏里先写下不知道，

pairs.target: děng yuēdìng le zài tián rén míng .
pairs.english: and fill in a name only after making arrangements.

pairs.target: huíláng xià , tǎ wéi yòu bǎ biǎo kàn le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Back in the corridor, Tavi looked the form over one more time.
pairs.hanzi: 回廊下，塔维又把表看了一遍。

pairs.target: shàngmiàn sāngè shíchén dōu xiě dé zhěngqí ,
pairs.english: All three times were written quite neatly on it,
pairs.hanzi: 上面三个时辰都写得整齐，

pairs.target: tā què zhǐ zhīdào zìjǐ de .
pairs.english: but he knew only his own.

pairs.target: yīwén cóng lìngyìtóu zǒulái ,
pairs.english: Iven came from the other end,

pairs.target: shǒulǐ yě ná zhe biǎo .
pairs.english: holding a form in his hand too.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn tā xiě dào nǎlǐ ,
pairs.english: Tavi asked how far he'd gotten.

pairs.target: tā shuō xiě dào guì kǒu guānmén yǐhòu ,
pairs.english: He said he'd reached the part after the counter closed.
pairs.hanzi: 他说写到柜口关门以后，

pairs.target: yuánlái xiǎng chá de nà bǐ qián yòu dé děng yírì .
pairs.english: The payment he had meant to look into would have to wait another day.
pairs.hanzi: 原来想查的那笔钱又得等一日。

pairs.target: tāmen yìtóng zài chuāng biān tíngxià ,
pairs.english: Together they stopped by the window

pairs.target: bǎ gèzì de zhǐ yā zài tóng yíkuài shítou dǐxià .
pairs.english: and weighed their respective sheets down under the same stone.
pairs.hanzi: 把各自的纸压在同一块石头底下。

pairs.target: fēngchuī qǐ liǎngzhāng zhǐ de jiǎo ,
pairs.english: The wind lifted the corners of both sheets,

pairs.target: lùchū dǐxià tóngyàng kōng zhe de yì gé .
pairs.english: revealing an identical blank box underneath each.
pairs.hanzi: 露出底下同样空着的一格。
